description: This bar chart illustrates the win/loss rates of three language models – Claude 3.5, GPT-4o, and Doubao – in a series of interactions. The horizontal axis represents the models, labeled Claude 3.5, GPT-4o, and Doubao, in that order from top to bottom. The vertical axis represents the proportion of wins or losses, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Each model is represented by a set of three stacked bars, colored light pink, light blue, and light green, representing “Win”, “Lose”, and an unspecified category, respectively. For Claude 3.5, the “Win” bar reaches approximately 0.32, the “Lose” bar reaches approximately 0.44, and the third bar reaches approximately 0.24. For GPT-4o, the “Win” bar reaches approximately 0.56, the “Lose” bar reaches approximately 0.18, and the third bar reaches approximately 0.26. For Doubao, the “Win” bar reaches approximately 0.42, the “Lose” bar reaches approximately 0.36, and the third bar reaches approximately 0.22. The bars are stacked vertically for each model, representing the proportion of each outcome. A legend at the bottom of the chart indicates the color corresponding to each outcome. No bars are visually emphasized.
